1→# Auto-Claude Configuration for Adamastor
     2→
     3→This file provides instructions for Auto-Claude agents working on Adamastor issues.
     4→
     5→## Critical Rules
     6→
     7→1. **Branch from staging** - All branches MUST be created from `staging`, never from `main`
     8→2. **PRs target staging** - All pull requests MUST target `staging`, never `main`
     9→3. **Regression tests required** - Every bug fix MUST include an E2E regression test
    10→4. **Reply to all PR comments** - Never leave review comments without responses
    11→5. **Wait for CI** - Do not request review until all CI checks are green
    12→
    13→## Complete Workflow
    14→
    15→### 1. Branch Creation
    16→```bash
    17→git checkout staging
    18→git pull origin staging
    19→git checkout -b <type>/issue-<number>-<short-description>
    20→```
    21→- Types: `fix/`, `feat/`, `refactor/`, `docs/`, `chore/`
    22→- Example: `fix/issue-42-district-filter`
    23→
    24→### 2. Issue Comment
    25→Post a comment on the issue stating:
    26→- What you're working on
    27→- Your planned approach
    28→- Any questions or clarifications
    29→
    30→### 3. Implementation
    31→- Read relevant files
    32→- Reproduce the problem (for bugs)
    33→- Implement the fix or feature
    34→- Run tests: `bun run test`
    35→
    36→### 4. E2E Regression Test (Bug Fixes Only)
    37→**MANDATORY** for all bug fixes. Add test to appropriate spec file in `apps/web/e2e/`:
    38→- `home.spec.ts` - Homepage bugs
    39→- `navigation.spec.ts` - Navigation bugs
    40→- `leaderboard.spec.ts` - Ranking page bugs
    41→- `postal-codes.spec.ts` - Postal code bugs
    42→- `parties.spec.ts` - Party page bugs
    43→
    44→Pattern:
    45→```typescript
    46→// Issue #XX: Brief title
    47→// @see https://github.com/bcamarneiro/adamastor/issues/XX
    48→test('descriptive test name', async ({ page }) => {
    49→  // Test the specific user flow that was broken
    50→});
    51→```
    52→
    53→Test locally: `cd apps/web && npx playwright test <spec-file>`
    54→
    55→### 5. Commit
    56→Format: `<type>(<scope>): <description> (#<issue-number>)`
    57→- Example: `fix(web): resolve district filter 400 error (#42)`
    58→- Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`
    59→
    60→### 6. Create PR
    61→```bash
    62→git push -u origin <branch-name>
    63→gh pr create --base staging --title "..." --body "Closes #<number>
    64→
    65→## What
    66→[Brief description]
    67→
    68→## Why
    69→[Why this change is needed]
    70→
    71→## How
    72→[Implementation details]
    73→
    74→## Testing
    75→- [ ] Unit tests pass
    76→- [ ] E2E tests pass (for bug fixes)
    77→- [ ] Manual testing completed
    78→"
    79→```
    80→
    81→**CRITICAL**: Use `--base staging`, NOT `--base main`.
    82→
    83→### 7. Wait for CI and Check for Copilot Comments
    84→
    85→#### Step 7a: Wait for CI to complete
    86→
    87→```bash
    88→gh run watch <run-id>
    89→```
    90→
    91→- All checks must pass: lint, typecheck, test-watcher, test-web, e2e, build
    92→- If CI fails, fix and push again
    93→
    94→#### Step 7b: Check for GitHub Copilot review comments
    95→
    96→**CRITICAL**: Before marking as ready for human review, check if Copilot already left comments:
    97→
    98→```bash
    99→# Check for any review comments
   100→gh pr view <number> --json reviews,comments --jq '.reviews[], .comments[]'
   101→```
   102→
   103→If Copilot (or any automated reviewer) left comments:
   104→
   105→1. Address ALL comments following step 8 below
   106→2. Push fixes
   107→3. Wait for CI to pass again
   108→4. Verify all comments have replies
   109→5. Only then mark as ready for human review
   110→
   111→**Never send a PR to human review with:**
   112→
   113→- ❌ Failing CI checks
   114→- ❌ Unaddressed Copilot comments
   115→- ❌ Review comments without replies
   116→
   117→### 8. Address PR Review Comments
   118→If the PR receives review comments (from Copilot or humans):
   119→
   120→1. Check for comments:
   121→   ```bash
   122→   gh pr view <number> --comments
   123→   ```
   124→
   125→2. For each comment:
   126→   - Make the fix if appropriate
   127→   - Reply individually:
   128→     ```bash
   129→     gh api repos/bcamarneiro/adamastor/pulls/comments/<comment-id>/replies \
   130→       -f body="Fixed in commit <sha>. <description>"
   131→     ```
   132→   - OR explain why not changing:
   133→     ```bash
   134→     gh api repos/bcamarneiro/adamastor/pulls/comments/<comment-id>/replies \
   135→       -f body="Won't fix: <reasoning>"
   136→     ```
   137→
   138→3. After addressing all comments:
   139→   - Push fixes
   140→   - Wait for CI to pass
   141→   - Re-request review:
   142→     ```bash
   143→     gh pr edit <number> --add-reviewer @bcamarneiro
   144→     ```
   145→
   146→**CRITICAL**: Every comment must receive a reply.
   147→
   148→## Project Context
   149→
   150→**What is Adamastor?**
   151→Portuguese Parliament transparency platform tracking deputy attendance and performance.
   152→
   153→**Tech Stack:**
   154→- Monorepo with Turborepo
   155→- Bun (watcher), Vite (web)
   156→- TypeScript (strict mode)
   157→- Testing: Bun test (watcher), Vitest + Playwright E2E (web)
   158→- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
   159→- UI: React + Radix UI + Tailwind CSS
   160→- Linting: Biome (not ESLint/Prettier)
   161→
   162→**Key Files:**

   165→- `packages/shared/src/types.ts` - Shared TypeScript types

   167→

   169→- **Legislatura** - Legislative term (currently XVII/17th)
   170→- **Deputado** - Deputy/MP
   171→- **Distrito** - Electoral district (22 total)
   172→- **Partido** - Political party (PS, PSD, CH, IL, BE, etc.)
   173→

   175→
   176→❌ Branching from `main` instead of `staging`
   177→❌ Creating PRs to `main` instead of `staging`
   178→❌ Forgetting E2E regression tests for bug fixes
   179→❌ Leaving PR review comments without replies
   180→❌ Requesting review before CI passes
   181→❌ Using `any` types in TypeScript
   182→❌ Modifying existing database migrations (create new ones)

   198→# E2E tests

   201→```
   202→

    CODING = "coding"
    QA_REVIEW = "qa_review"
    QA_FIXING = "qa_fixing"
    COMPLETE = "complete"
    FAILED = "failed"


def emit_phase(
    phase: ExecutionPhase | str,
    message: str = "",
    *,
    progress: int | None = None,
    subtask: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Emit structured phase event to stdout for frontend parsing."""
    phase_value = phase.value if isinstance(phase, ExecutionPhase) else phase

    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "phase": phase_value,
        "message": message,
    }

    if progress is not None:
        if not (0 <= progress <= 100):
            progress = max(0, min(100, progress))
        payload["progress"] = progress

    if subtask is not None:
        payload["subtask"] = subtask

    try:
        print(f"{PHASE_MARKER_PREFIX}{json.dumps(payload, default=str)}", flush=True)
